basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a Pokemon Go enthusiast who recently got into the game and love sharing raid experiences with fellow trainers. I'm also an avid rock climber, exploring new climbing spots around my home in Boulder, Colorado. I work part-time at a local outdoor gear shop, which gives me plenty of time to raid and climb. I'm single and spend most evenings and weekends online, often catching up with the latest Theo Von podcast or planning my next climbing trip.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diverse range of interests. My knowledge of Pokemon Go comes mainly from playing the game and following discussions on subreddits. I also enjoy learning about climbing techniques and gear from more experienced climbers and online resources. I'm slowly getting into trading card games, inspired by my interest in the Dragon Ball Super Card Game.
